Players Committee card image of [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “The Mythrol's game text may not be canceled. If about to leave table, place out of play. During start of game, may reveal this card from outside your deck to replace a just-deployed Jabba's Prize imprisoned in Security Tower. If not revealed during start of game, place this card under your Starting Effect. [Set 1] Despair targets The Mythrol instead of Jabba's Prize. Cancels Stunning Leader here. If just released, either flip this card or place it out of play.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/themythrolfront.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/daa9e8850812f8507643184df20ca85fbe4d05e7 daa9e88] (22 April 2022). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
